notes.title: MASSIVE UPDATE! KEYBOARD FUNCTIONALITY IS HERE!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31272915/30e69d90a4a079edac550afa2c6cd47dff95b005.png[/img]

Full keyboard usage is now available in Talsaluq: Tower of Infinity. In addition to this, gamepads and mouses still remain available as well.

This update allows for a complete and diverse gaming experience. The game's tutorial has been updated to incorporate all three variants of control. Good luck, and have fun!

notes.title: December Event is LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31272915/6acc1f31b26f85ed0ba36174f3c136d50f3134d2.png[/img]

Play the game, defeat the golem, and win prizes! Also, don't forget to head over to Twitter to receive a special passcode to unlock a new avatar!

In addition to the event, this update also comes with a patch that makes the following corrections:

- Stone of Calamity ceases to deal damage when stairway is reached
- Game no longer saves at 50th Floor Corrdior


Good luck, and have fun!

notes.title: PATCH UPDATE (12-16-17)
notes.content:
This patch makes the following corrections:

- Switches are reset upon leaving the floor (does not apply to Events)
- Money Pots on the 33rd Floor are now visible

Patch updates will be made whenever necessary. Do be sure to post any requests you may have for patches in the Community Hub.
